content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-9|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Stripe alternatives

Platform restrictions often hinder digital [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-one-afternoon-2|COREMERCH guide to creators]] in Nigeria from accessing mainstream payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-what-nobody-17|Solutions When]] like Stripe and PayPal. These platforms have stringent eligibility criteria and geographical limitations, which exclude many potential users. For instance, a PayPal account suspension can lock funds for up to 180 days without any chance of appeal. This creates a precarious situation for creators who rely on seamless transactions to sustain their businesses. The need for a reliable alternative is clear — a solution that provides not just temporary relief, but a permanent structural change in how creators engage with their audience and monetize their work.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a decentralized model, allowing creators to retain full control over their sales and transactions. Instead of depending on third-party platforms, creators can deploy their own digital storefronts using tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Payment verification is handled through NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture ensures that creators not only own their data but also operate independently, free from the constraints imposed by traditional payment processors. By leveraging a combination of open-source and free tools, creators can build a robust online presence quickly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically tailored for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are either unavailable or prohibitively restrictive. In Nigeria, Ghana, and other countries, creators are often locked out of platforms that many elsewhere take for granted. This system empowers creators to operate without the fear of account suspensions or payment delays. Whether selling ebooks, courses, or digital assets, this approach allows creators to focus on their craft rather than worrying about platform limitations. By providing a sovereign solution, we enable a new era of digital commerce that is inclusive and resilient.
Digital creators deserve architectural independence.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of sovereign commerce infrastructure hinges on its core components working in unison. Creators can use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting their sites, while backend operations can be streamlined with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Order management is facilitated by platforms like Supabase or even Google Sheets, allowing for seamless data storage. File delivery can be handled through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that products are delivered instantly upon purchase. The integration of NOWPayments allows for automatic payment processing, which significantly reduces the complexity of handling transactions. Each piece of this puzzle plays a vital role in creating a reliable digital storefront.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started on setting up your sovereign commerce infrastructure, first choose your hosting solution, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, write the backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle orders and payments. Store your product data in Supabase or Google Sheets. Use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for product delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. By following these steps, you can set up a fully operational online store in under 48 hours using the Edge Commerce Stack for just $197. Your Deployment Checklist

Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
